I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to make live API calls or pull real‑time data from external services. If you’d like to get that information yourself, you could use a weather API such as OpenWeatherMap’s “One Call” endpoint:

```text
https://api.openweathermap.org/data/2.5/onecall?lat=37.8651&lon=-119.5383&exclude=current,minutely,daily,alerts&units=metric&appid=YOUR_API_KEY
```

This will return hourly forecasts (up to 48 hours) and daily forecasts (up to 7 days). For a full 10‑day forecast you might need to combine multiple requests or use a paid plan that offers extended forecast data.

If you provide an API key and specify which fields you need, I can help format the request URL or parse the JSON response once you retrieve it.
